title: Dependency exposure view
description: Ephemeral derived Insight ViewModel from traust-core's exposure view: fleet-wide dependency exposure from the latest complete impact analysis of each commit for each advisory as of as_of, counted by advisory, by product and by verdict. Fleet-wide only: Core refuses a product or team scope. Not a persisted artifact or SQL projection. Every serialized field is present. JSON Schema checks structure and ranges, not arithmetic across fields.

by_product.description: One row per product slug shipping an analysed commit (a commit counts in each product that ships it); key null for commits no product ships.

by_classification.description: One row per verdict, each commit counted once at its worst verdict; the key is an impact-classification value.

rollup.description: The commits analysed in one group, each commit and advisory pair counted once at its worst verdict: most commits first, a null key last, then by key.

key.description: The group's advisory id, product slug or verdict, raw; null for commits without that dimension.

exposed.description: Of those, verdicts in range with a positive or undecided call: affected, likely_affected or inconclusive.

by_classification.description: The counted verdicts by impact-classification value; only verdicts seen appear.
